properties.site-address: Broad Street Mall, Oxford Road, Reading
properties.notes: Proposed allocation CR12d in Submission Draft Local Plan. The site will be used for continued retail and leisure provision, maintaining frontages along Oxford Street and St Mary’s Butts, and improving frontages to Hosier Street and Queens Walk, with uses including residential, with some potential for offices, on upper floors. This may be achieved by comprehensive redevelopment.
